verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below.

notes: The amendment applies exactly the consequences enumerated in the adopted review and the HDI-RUNG2-005 record; the failure-handling rule and the pre-written pack criteria are untouched.
The remaining-gates list in LADDER_STATUS.md was renumbered after collapsing the resolved adoption gate, avoiding the duplicate-numbering defect previously fixed in v0.3.
Wall-clock remains a criterion (sponsor's Option A) while the new precondition moves the known failure mode to envelope-review time, so honesty rules and goalposts both survive the redesign.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the six authorized files.

friction_notes: Sixth recording mission with near-identical envelope boilerplate; the parked recording-mission template candidate keeps accruing evidence.
The decision-to-recorded latency for HDI-RUNG2-005 was minutes, in-thread; the lane's heaviest cost remains envelope ceremony, not decision latency.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: A criterion survived a redesign it had just failed twice, because the redesign relocated the failure to the artifact that caused it (the envelope) — goalpost stability and failure-mode repair are compatible when the diagnosis names the right artifact.

The adopted coefficients make envelope review partly arithmetic: a reviewer can check scope sufficiency by multiplication before any run, which is a new, cheap, pre-Go verification surface for this lane.
